status: supplemental mathematical construction, not replacement of source scenario
policies: all observable-history adaptive/randomized policies; independent seeds; central shared memory envelope for any finite team; known denials rejected; no reset of V
cost: all trial setup b, each material segment g including local geometry/review/decision/effect; additional informative coordinate c>0 full producer+receiver price; aggregate team work

probabilities.eta: technical high-quality completion within declared profile budget/deadline; supplementary only
probabilities.sigma: joint technical completion and no violation; maps to original success on these supplemental DAG profiles
probabilities.AVG: joint declared world law and policy randomness
probabilities.WC: same policy, eta>=h and rho<=r in every world, policy randomness only

F.actions: M always admissible benefit1; X/Y benefit2 matched to local bit; all adjacent mixtures
F.query: single raw coordinate, exact available price c; no global predicate service

W.worlds: G all1 weight1/2; B_j unique zero j weight1/(2n)
W.actions: M1 always; A2 valid iff f1; B2 valid iff f0, stable mandate; all mixtures
W.quality: epsilon0, all L high for Ttec
W.query: single raw normative coordinate, exact price c
W.receipt: f revealed after first A/B effect; subsequent allowed completion, V latch retained
W.dense_family: n=L*(L-1)/2, L>=2; fixed b,g,c and h>2r

caps: finite per instance, large enough for n/L full-information controls; no inherited constant 32 extrapolation

technologies.raw_price: lower bound c_min permits lower bounds only; controls require availability/upper prices
technologies.global_certificate: current sufficient authenticated f (W) or vector (F), full additional price f; hard critical slack min(old,f)
technologies.authorized_dispatch: select+execute correct high action, full extra fee a per high segment; distinct protected-only subprofile; a0 additional may be included inside g
technologies.retry_barrier: Protected-only interface, no additional coordinate queries/certificates; 0<a<=g; every refused preeffect test charged a; accepted choice charged g including test; known-correct retry also g. Stop after paid rejection k+1, funded from unexecuted material reserve. All completions cost C0+a*rejections; eta binomial CDF. If added alongside queries, this is an achievable control, not the full optimal frontier.
technologies.scope: no arbitrary real-technology classification; absolute and relative budget meanings separated
